entertainment.nri_angle: Several award-winning films are streaming globally on Netflix, Prime Video, and Disney+ Hotstar, giving the diaspora direct access to India's best cinema.

entertainment.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Crosses Rs 15 Crore in India Presales With 12 Days Still to Go
entertainment.excerpt: Tom Holland's fourth solo Spider-Man film is on track for the second-biggest Hollywood opening day in India, with PVRINOX selling over 200,000 weekend tickets and Prasads in Hyderabad already sold out.
entertainment.image_caption: Tom Holland at a film premiere. Spider-Man: Brand New Day has crossed Rs 15 crore in India presales with nearly two weeks to go before its July 30 release.
entertainment.nri_angle: Spider-Man presales demonstrate India's growing box office clout and the franchise's massive following among Indian audiences globally

entertainment.title: Symphony Masala Brings Bollywood to American Orchestras for the First Time
entertainment.excerpt: Indian-American conductor Roger Kalia and vocalist Anuradha Palakurthi have created the first-ever symphonic arrangements of Bollywood music for Western instruments, with sold-out performances from New Hampshire to Santa Monica.
entertainment.image_caption: A symphony orchestra performs on a concert stage. Symphony Masala is the first project to arrange Bollywood songs for Western orchestral instruments.
entertainment.nri_angle: Symphony Masala offers Indian Americans and diaspora audiences a rare chance to hear Bollywood classics performed by full Western symphony orchestras, bridging cultural traditions in American concert halls.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Lenin Crosses ₹50 Crore Worldwide in Opening Week, Gives Akhil Akkineni His First Box Office Hit in 11 Years
entertainment.excerpt: The Telugu rural action drama, produced by Nagarjuna Akkineni's Annapurna Studios, recovered its entire investment within three days and has established Akhil as a viable leading man in Tollywood.
entertainment.image_caption: Akhil Akkineni in a promotional image. The actor's latest film Lenin has crossed ₹50 crore worldwide in its opening week, his first box office hit in an 11-year career.
entertainment.nri_angle: The film's overseas gross of ₹9.40 crore in its first week reflects strong demand among Telugu-speaking diaspora audiences for quality regional cinema.

lifestyle-health.title: Serum Institute to Manufacture World's First New TB Vaccine in a Century
lifestyle-health.excerpt: India's largest vaccine maker partners with Gates Medical Research Institute to produce M72/AS01E, investing over $100 million to prepare for potential approval of a shot that could prevent 76 million new TB cases globally.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A medical professional administers a vaccine injection. Serum Institute of India will manufacture the M72/AS01E tuberculosis vaccine candidate under a new agreement with the Gates Medical Research Institute.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Serum Institute's role in manufacturing a potential breakthrough TB vaccine highlights India's central position in global public health and its fight against the country's highest-burden infectious disease.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Turmeric's Health Benefits: What Science Says About the Golden Spice
lifestyle-health.excerpt: From easing joint pain to supporting heart health and memory, clinical research is validating what Ayurvedic practitioners have known for centuries about curcumin's anti-inflammatory power.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Ground turmeric powder and fresh turmeric root on a wooden surface. Clinical studies are validating the anti-inflammatory and pain-relief properties of curcumin, the golden spice's active compound.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Turmeric has been central to Indian cooking and Ayurvedic medicine for millennia; Western clinical research is now confirming health benefits long practiced in Indian households.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: How Chronic Stress Quietly Drives Up Blood Sugar and Diabetes Risk
lifestyle-health.excerpt: New research shows daily stress causes measurable glucose spikes in insulin-resistant individuals, reinforcing the case for stress management as a frontline diabetes prevention strategy.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A person uses a lancet pen and glucometer to test blood sugar levels. New research links chronic stress to measurable glucose spikes in insulin-resistant individuals.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians carry genetic predispositions that make them more vulnerable to stress-related glucose dysregulation, with India's 89.8 million diabetics and 43% undiagnosed rate making this a deeply personal issue for the diaspora.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Archana Puran Singh Adopts Strict Ayurvedic Routine After 15-Day Bengaluru Retreat
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The 63-year-old actor and Kapil Show regular has cut sugar, maida, and fried food from her diet, now eats dinner at 7 PM and sleeps by 10 PM after completing an Ayurvedic wellness programme.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Archana Puran Singh at a public event in 2024. The veteran actor recently completed a 15-day Ayurvedic wellness retreat in Bengaluru.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Ayurvedic wellness retreats in India are attracting rising interest from NRIs reconnecting with traditional health practices, with centres in Karnataka, Kerala, and Goa reporting increased bookings from overseas visitors.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Dementia Risk Factors Vary Sharply Across Countries, Lancet Study Finds
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A new analysis of 214,000 older adults across 14 countries reveals that while the risk factors for dementia differ dramatically by region, they cluster in strikingly similar patterns worldwide.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A doctor holds an elderly patient's hands during a consultation. A new cross-national study finds that dementia risk factors like education, obesity, and hypertension vary sharply across 14 countries.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian immigrants may carry distinct lifetime risk profiles shaped by conditions in India, where low education and vision loss dominate dementia risk, rather than the obesity and social isolation patterns common in Western countries.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Ankita Konwar Becomes First Assamese Woman to Cross the English Channel, Learned to Swim Just Three Years Ago
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The endurance athlete and wife of fitness icon Milind Soman completed the iconic Dover-to-Calais crossing as part of an international relay team, marking the 100th anniversary of the first woman's Channel swim.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: An open-water swimmer cuts through the waves wearing a bright swim cap. Ankita Konwar completed the English Channel relay crossing on July 3, becoming the first woman from Northeast India to achieve the feat.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Konwar's journey from non-swimmer to Channel crosser in three years celebrates extraordinary Indian achievement and Northeast Indian representation on the global stage.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Why Summer Sunshine Alone Won't Fix Vitamin D Deficiency — Especially for South Asians
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A new UK study finds vitamin D levels barely improve even in summer for older adults and people with darker skin. For Indians — at home and in the diaspora — the problem runs deeper than a lack of sunlight.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Sunlight streaming through a natural setting. A new study finds that summer sunshine alone is insufficient to correct vitamin D deficiency for older adults and people with darker skin.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians face compounding risk factors for vitamin D deficiency — darker skin pigmentation, northern-latitude living and vegetarian diets — making year-round supplementation essential.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Cyclospora Parasite Outbreak Sickens Thousands Across the US With Taco Bell Lettuce Under Scrutiny
lifestyle-health.excerpt: More than 5,100 possible cases of cyclosporiasis have been reported across 30 states, with shredded iceberg lettuce from a Mexican supplier linked to infections at Taco Bell.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Fresh lettuce leaves displayed at a grocery store. Federal investigators have linked shredded iceberg lettuce from a Mexican facility to a cyclosporiasis outbreak affecting more than 5,100 people across the United States.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Directly affects Indians living in the US who eat at chain restaurants and buy produce from major grocery stores.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Kerala's Monsoon Flu Crisis: 4,405 Influenza Cases and 49 Deaths in 2026
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Kerala is grappling with a severe influenza outbreak driven by H1N1 and other strains as monsoon season intensifies, with the state recording the highest flu-related fatalities among all communicable diseases this year.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A healthcare worker prepares medical supplies at a clinic. Kerala's public health infrastructure has been mobilized across all districts to manage the influenza surge during the 2026 monsoon season.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The outbreak poses a direct concern for the large Keralite diaspora, many of whom travel home during the monsoon season. Health experts advise travelers to India's southern states to get vaccinated before visiting and take standard respiratory precautions.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Ozempic and Cancer: Why the Promising Headlines Outpace the Science
lifestyle-health.excerpt: More than two dozen studies presented at a major oncology conference suggest GLP-1 drugs may reduce cancer risk, but researchers warn the evidence is observational and clinical trials are still needed.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A semaglutide injection pen, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy. Researchers are investigating whether GLP-1 drugs may have anti-cancer properties beyond their established metabolic benefits.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asian communities face elevated diabetes and metabolic syndrome rates, making GLP-1 drug findings on cancer risk especially relevant for India and the diaspora.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: India Approves Wegovy for Fatty Liver Disease in New Milestone for GLP-1 Drugs
lifestyle-health.excerpt: India's drug regulator has cleared Novo Nordisk's semaglutide injection for treating MASH, a serious form of fatty liver disease that affects roughly two in three Indians, making it the first GLP-1 drug approved for this condition both globally and in India.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A medical professional prepares a syringe for injection. Wegovy is administered as a once-weekly subcutaneous injection using a prefilled pen device.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians are disproportionately susceptible to metabolic liver disease, and the approval gives family in India access to a treatment previously limited to Western markets.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Seven High-Protein Vegetarian Snacks to Power Through Your Workday Without Chana or Makhana
food.excerpt: From sprouted moong salads to paneer cubes and almond-date bites, these Indian-friendly snacks deliver real protein without a stove or elaborate prep.
food.image_caption: Assorted roasted nuts in a steel bowl. Simple, high-protein vegetarian snacks can help busy professionals maintain energy throughout the workday.
food.nri_angle: Vegetarian protein remains a common dietary challenge for Indian Americans navigating Western workplaces; practical snack ideas fill a real need.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How Sanjeev Kapoor's Parents Shaped India's Most Famous Chef
food.excerpt: From an Ambala boy who didn't know what a chef was to a Padma Shri-winning culinary icon — Kapoor credits his parents' unconventional support and values for his extraordinary journey.
food.image_caption: Chef Sanjeev Kapoor at a restaurant launch event in Mumbai. Kapoor credits his parents for the confidence and values that took him from Ambala to the top of India's culinary world.
food.nri_angle: Kapoor's show Khana Khazana aired in 120 countries and his restaurants operate across Dubai, Kuwait, and North America, making him a culinary touchstone for Indians abroad.

food.title: Colorado Springs' Indian Food Festival Returns for Fourth Year on Aug. 1
food.excerpt: The free, family-friendly event at Liberty High School will feature a dozen Indian food vendors, cultural performances, dandiya dance lessons, and a fashion show, with 30% of proceeds going to charity.
food.image_caption: A traditional Kerala Sadya spread served on a banana leaf, featuring rice, curries, pickles, and accompaniments. The Indian Food Festival in Colorado Springs will showcase regional dishes from across India on Aug. 1.
food.nri_angle: The festival offers Indian Americans in Colorado a rare concentrated showcase of regional Indian cuisine and cultural programming, strengthening community ties in the Pikes Peak region.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Bengal's Chingri Malai Curry Ranks Among the World's Best Shrimp Dishes on TasteAtlas, the Only Indian Entry in the Top 50
food.excerpt: The coconut-milk prawn curry, a Bengali wedding and festival staple, has earned 11th place in TasteAtlas' global ranking of best shrimp dishes — beating out entries from Japan, Thailand, and Indonesia.
food.image_caption: Chingri Malai Curry, a Bengali prawn dish cooked in coconut milk with garam masala, earned 11th place in TasteAtlas' global ranking of the best shrimp dishes. It is the only Indian entry in the top 50.
food.nri_angle: The recognition puts Bengali diaspora food culture on the global stage, with the dish widely enjoyed among Indian communities abroad.

food.title: Mumbai's Iconic Ashok Vada Pav Earns Global Recognition on TasteAtlas' World's Most Iconic Sandwiches List
food.excerpt: The 60-year-old Dadar street stall that invented vada pav has been ranked 25th among the world's most iconic sandwiches by the global food guide, putting Mumbai's signature snack on the international map.
food.image_caption: A freshly made vada pav served on a plate. Mumbai's Ashok Vada Pav has been ranked among the world's most iconic sandwiches by global food guide TasteAtlas.
food.nri_angle: The international recognition of vada pav resonates deeply with the Mumbai diaspora and Indians abroad who grew up with the iconic street food.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sanjeev Kapoor Takes Indian Cuisine to MasterChef Australia, Challenges Contestants to Cook With Indian Flavors
food.excerpt: India's most recognized chef appeared as a guest judge on Season 18, bringing a mystery box of Indian ingredients and praising a contestant's creative take on dal and curry.
food.image_caption: Celebrity chef Sanjeev Kapoor at a restaurant launch event. Kapoor recently appeared as a guest judge on MasterChef Australia Season 18.
food.nri_angle: Kapoor's appearance on one of the world's most prestigious cooking shows elevates the profile of Indian cuisine globally and is a point of pride for the diaspora.

food.title: Indienne Brings Chicago's Only Michelin-Starred Indian Cuisine to New York's Hudson Yards
food.excerpt: Chef Sujan Sarkar opens a 34-seat outpost of his acclaimed progressive Indian tasting menu restaurant, joining a surge of high-profile Indian fine dining in Manhattan.
food.image_caption: An Indian fine dining table setting. Chef Sujan Sarkar's Michelin-starred Indienne has opened a 34-seat outpost in New York's Hudson Yards neighborhood.
food.nri_angle: The expansion of Michelin-level Indian dining in America's most competitive restaurant market represents a cultural milestone for Indian Americans.

food.title: India's ₹1.5 Lakh Crore Mithai Industry Goes Global as Exports Surge 10 Percent Annually
food.excerpt: Gulab jamun is now one of the UK's most popular desserts, and Haldiram's ships to North America, Japan and Southeast Asia as demand expands beyond the diaspora.
food.image_caption: A tray of assorted Indian sweets. India's ₹1.5 lakh crore mithai and namkeen industry now exports about 10% of its production, with shipments growing over 10% annually.
food.nri_angle: NRIs can increasingly access authentic mithai during festivals as export infrastructure expands, with Haldiram's and other major manufacturers shipping to the US, Canada, Singapore, Japan and European markets.

food.title: Houston's Mahatma Gandhi District Is America's Best Indian Food Corridor
food.excerpt: From Michelin-starred fine dining to $3 jalebi at a 40-year-old sweet shop, Houston's Hillcroft corridor and beyond offer the most diverse Indian food scene in the United States.
food.image_caption: An Indian thali with curry, rice, naan, and accompaniments. Houston's Indian food scene ranges from casual thali plates to Michelin-starred tasting menus.
food.nri_angle: Houston's 300,000-strong South Asian community has built a restaurant ecosystem that serves as cultural infrastructure for celebrations, wedding functions, and everyday connection to regional flavors from across the Indian subcontinent.

food.title: New York Indian Dining Scene Reaches New Heights With Wave of Ambitious Openings
food.excerpt: From Michelin-starred tasting menus to Kerala coastal cuisine, a surge of Indian restaurants is rewriting the city's culinary map in 2026.

food.nri_angle: The wave of ambitious Indian restaurants in New York — from Kerala coastal cuisine to Michelin-starred tasting menus — gives the metro area's 800,000-plus Indian Americans unprecedented access to hyper-regional flavors from home.

travel.nri_angle: Indian families across the US can enjoy the Perseids as a free, accessible outdoor activity — ideal for a summer weekend with kids.

travel.title: How a New Jersey Boutique Hotel Became the World Cup's Most Trusted Team Base
travel.excerpt: The MC Hotel in Montclair has hosted four national teams during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, including Spain ahead of Sunday's final against Argentina at MetLife Stadium.
travel.image_caption: Soccer fans celebrating during the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The MC Hotel in Montclair, New Jersey, has become a trusted base for national teams competing at MetLife Stadium.
travel.nri_angle: World Cup venue accommodations and experiences near MetLife Stadium relevant to diaspora fans attending the final.

travel.title: Amarnath and Vaishno Devi Yatra Suspended as Heavy Rain and Landslides Batter Jammu and Kashmir
travel.excerpt: Authorities halted both pilgrimages after 36 hours of nonstop rainfall damaged routes and triggered landslides, with one woman killed near Baltal. NRIs planning trips should monitor conditions before traveling.
travel.image_caption: The Amarnath Cave shrine in Jammu and Kashmir. Heavy rainfall and landslides have forced authorities to suspend both the Amarnath Yatra and Vaishno Devi Yatra across the region (Wikimedia Commons).
travel.nri_angle: Thousands of NRIs travel to India annually for the Amarnath and Vaishno Devi pilgrimages; suspension during peak season directly affects diaspora travel plans.

travel.title: Gulf Airspace Closures and Flight Cancellations Disrupt Travel for Millions of Indians Across the Middle East
travel.excerpt: Kuwait, Bahrain, and UAE face widespread aviation disruptions as military activity forces airspace restrictions, with EASA advising airlines to avoid Gulf routes until July 29.
travel.image_caption: Commercial aircraft at an airport terminal. Airlines across the Gulf region are adjusting schedules as military activity forces airspace closures and widespread flight cancellations.
travel.nri_angle: Millions of Indians live and work across the Gulf states, and the flight disruptions during peak summer travel season directly affect their ability to travel home.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India to Restore Most Suspended International Routes From September as Summer Cuts End
travel.excerpt: Tata-backed carrier says flights from September are already on sale, but Chicago and Washington routes remain grounded due to aircraft constraints and Pakistan airspace closure.
travel.image_caption: An Air India Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner operating the Mumbai-London route. The airline expects to restore most of its suspended international capacity from September 2026.
travel.nri_angle: Air India's route restoration directly affects NRI travel between India and the US, UK, and Australia, though Chicago and Washington suspensions continue to impact key diaspora corridors.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Beyond Pangong: 7 Offbeat Ladakh Destinations Worth the Detour
travel.excerpt: From a Balti village on the Line of Control to a cliffside monastery in Zanskar, Ladakh's quieter corners reward travellers who venture past the standard tourist loop.
travel.image_caption: A mountain lake in Leh surrounded by rugged terrain under dramatic skies. Ladakh recorded 117,546 tourist arrivals between January and May 2026, a 43% increase over the same period last year.
travel.nri_angle: For NRIs planning a trip home, offbeat Ladakh destinations offer experiences that rival international adventure travel — at a fraction of the cost — but require Inner Line Permits and a narrow June-September travel window.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: How Wars in the Middle East and Europe Are Reshaping the Way Indians Travel Abroad
travel.excerpt: Rerouted flights, surging airfares, and drone disruptions are turning Indian travelers into strategic planners who prioritize flexibility over destination.
travel.image_caption: Passengers check departure boards at an airport terminal. Indian travelers are facing rerouted flights and surging airfares as geopolitical conflicts disrupt major air corridors.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs traveling between India and the West face longer flights, higher fares, and disrupted routes due to Middle East and European conflicts, while domestic Indian tourism surges.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Delhi-Rishikesh Namo Bharat Rail Extension Gets Green Light, Promising Three-Hour Travel Time
travel.excerpt: The 150-kilometre high-speed rail corridor from Meerut to Rishikesh has received in-principle approval from three governments, with a detailed project report survey set to begin soon.
travel.image_caption: Namo Bharat RRTS trains at a station on the Delhi-Meerut corridor. The high-speed rail service will be extended to Rishikesh, reducing travel time from Delhi to approximately three hours.
travel.nri_angle: Faster Delhi-Rishikesh connectivity benefits returning NRIs who visit for yoga retreats, pilgrimages and Himalayan holidays.

carousel.title: EU Gives Caribbean Nations Until 2028 to End Citizenship-for-Sale Programs or Lose Schengen Access
carousel.excerpt: The European Commission has formally demanded that five Eastern Caribbean states phase out their citizenship-by-investment programs by June 2028, with interim vetting measures due by September this year.
carousel.image_caption: The European Commission headquarters in Brussels, where officials drafted the demand for Caribbean nations to end citizenship-by-investment programs. The deadline marks the EU's most direct move against golden passport schemes.
carousel.nri_angle: The crackdown reflects a global tightening of investor citizenship pathways that Indian nationals have used as alternative routes to visa-free travel and business mobility.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Kerala Walks Back Tata Shipyard Claim: ₹10,000 Crore Figure Is a Long-Term Maritime Vision, Not a Deal
carousel.excerpt: After CM Satheesan told media that Tata was ready to invest $1 billion in shipbuilding, the state government clarified that no single deal has been struck.
carousel.image_caption: The Vizhinjam port in Kerala, part of the state's expanding maritime infrastructure. Kerala is positioning itself as a shipbuilding hub under its Mission Samudra initiative.
carousel.nri_angle: Kerala's push to become a maritime hub reflects the state's economic ambitions that directly interest the large Malayali diaspora invested in their home state's development.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas Nominated for Critics Choice Super Award for The Bluff, Adding to Breakout Awards Season
carousel.excerpt: The Indian actress competes for Best Actress in an Action Movie alongside Pamela Anderson and Charlize Theron, following her recent Emmy nomination for Heads of State.
carousel.image_caption: Priyanka Chopra Jonas at a promotional event in 2024. The actress earned a Critics Choice Super Award nomination for her role in The Bluff, her second nomination from the Critics Choice Association.
carousel.nri_angle: Priyanka Chopra Jonas is the most prominent Indian actress working in Hollywood, and her growing awards recognition reflects the expanding presence of Indian talent in mainstream Western cinema.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Spain and Argentina Set for World Cup Final as Messi's Last Dance Meets Falklands Controversy
carousel.excerpt: Sunday's final at MetLife Stadium pits the defending champions against the Euro 2024 winners, with the buildup dominated by a diplomatic row over an Argentine banner and the question of whether Messi's career ends in triumph or defeat.
carousel.image_caption: The 2026 FIFA World Cup final between Spain and Argentina takes place at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey on Sunday. It could be the last international match of Lionel Messi's career.
carousel.nri_angle: The World Cup final is being watched passionately across the Indian diaspora, with Delhi cafes staying open until 4 AM and viewing parties organized in Indian communities across the US and UK.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Tech Layoffs Surge Past 150,000 in 2026 as AI Reshapes the American Workforce
carousel.excerpt: Meta, Amazon, Oracle, and Thomson Reuters lead a wave of cuts that has eliminated more jobs in six months than the full-year total in 2025, with software engineers bearing the brunt of AI-driven restructuring.
carousel.image_caption: A technology company workspace in Silicon Valley. More than 150,000 tech workers have been laid off in 2026 as companies accelerate AI adoption and restructure engineering teams.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian tech professionals, who make up 4.3% of America's AI workforce and hold a significant share of H-1B visas, are disproportionately affected by the layoffs and face additional visa-related complications when losing employment.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India-UK Free Trade Pact Takes Effect, Targeting $100 Billion in Bilateral Trade by 2030
carousel.excerpt: The landmark agreement eliminates duties on 99% of Indian exports to Britain and exempts 75,000 Indian professionals from double social security contributions.
carousel.image_caption: India and the United Kingdom signed the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement in July 2025. The pact took effect on July 15, 2026, covering goods, services, and professional mobility.
carousel.nri_angle: The Double Contribution Convention exempts 75,000 Indian workers in the UK from paying into Britain's National Insurance system, directly benefiting the Indian diaspora.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
